description: This file is a C++ source code for a Google Test sample demonstrating a leak checker using custom test event listeners. It defines classes for tracking Water object allocations and a LeakChecker listener to detect leaks during tests, with test cases and main function to run tests with optional leak checking.

classes.name: Water
classes.description: A class that tracks its own memory allocations via custom new and delete operators.

classes.name: LeakChecker
classes.description: A custom Google Test event listener that checks for Water object leaks during tests.

methods.name: Water::operator new
methods.description: Custom new operator that increments allocation count and allocates memory.

methods.name: Water::operator delete
methods.description: Custom delete operator that decrements allocation count and frees memory.

methods.name: Water::allocated
methods.description: Returns the current number of allocated Water objects.

methods.name: LeakChecker::OnTestStart
methods.description: Records the number of Water objects before a test starts.

methods.name: LeakChecker::OnTestEnd
methods.description: Checks for Water object leaks after a test ends and reports failure if leaks are detected.
